We guess that this can be shown by proving that the function from Example 2 is not definable by any polynomial ambiguous weighted automata. 6 Conclusions and future work In this paper we proposed and investigated maximal partition logic. Our main result shows that MP is a logic characterization of BAC, a natural restriction of copyless CRA. MP has no syntactical restrictions and, in contrast to Weighted MSO, there is no division between the boolean and the quantitative parts of the logic. A mild restriction is put in the semantics of the logic since we allow only maximal intervals. Thanks to this semantic our formulas are usually more readable and easy to write (see Example 3).
